text: A public member of the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority (TRCA) Board has recently resigned. The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to fill this vacancy. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following the candidates to be interviewed at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority: TRC2-35 TRC2-63 TRC2-75 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (November 4, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority.
